pages.title: Chiral Ligand
pages.text: Two aromatic rings joined so that they cannot turn past each other: the molecule is left- or right-handed, and so is every metal it holds. Made from a Kekule Ring at the Synthesis Bench; held in the Asymmetric Reactor's catalyst slot.
Made in $(item)Synthesis Bench$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Asymmetric Synthesis.
